gizmo.title: Zane-zane daga rubutu
gizmo.description: Rubuta zane-zane a matsayin rubutu (Mermaid): zanen gudana, jerin, layin lokaci da sauransu. Ana zana shi a shafin tare da madadin rubutu.

configure.title: Take
configure.description: Ana nuna shi a saman zane-zanen kuma ana amfani da shi a matsayin sunansa.

configure.title: Tushen zane-zane
configure.description: Rubutun Mermaid, misali: flowchart TD, sannan layi ɗaya don kowane mahaɗi kamar A[Draft] --> B{Ready?}. Ƙara |label| bayan kibiya don ba ta lakabi. Zanen yana sabuntawa yayin da kake rubutu.

configure.title: Madadin rubutu
configure.description: Bayyana abin da zane-zanen ke nunawa don mutanen da ba sa iya ganinsa. Bar shi babu komai a zanen gudana don a jera maka matakansa.

configure.title: Taken hoto
configure.description: Taken zaɓi da ake nunawa ƙarƙashin zane-zanen.

configure.title: Nuna tushen
configure.description: Nuna rubutun zane-zane kusa da zanen.

configure.title: Nuna madadin rubutu
configure.description: Nuna madadin rubutu ƙarƙashin zanen. Koyaushe yana samuwa ga masu karanta allo.

advanced.title: Fayil ɗin tushe
advanced.description: Adireshin fayil ɗin .mmd da za a zana maimakon rubutun da ke sama (https ko hanya a wannan shafi).
